title: White Pedestal Arrangement
desc: A classical white urn arrangement of white hydrangea, phalaenopsis and roses over fine green foliage.

groups.label: Main flowers
groups.blurb: White blooms carrying the arrangement over the green base.

items.role: Petal-white hydrangea forming the full white body of the arrangement.
White phalaenopsis cascade falling over the rim on the right side.
White roses tucked between the hydrangea clusters.
Green round allium ball rising at the centre as a fresh green sphere.

groups.label: Greenery & grasses
groups.blurb: Feathery greens and fine line branches shaping the silhouette.

items.role: Light green feathery pine building the fresh green mass of the piece.
Tall fine-leafed branch rising above the arrangement for the high line.

groups.label: Vessel
groups.blurb: The classical container the arrangement is built in.

items.role: White Roman column footed urn holding the whole arrangement.
